chunks: And Ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Khallād, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who slaughtered a pigeon from the pigeons of the Haram,
He said: I said, "May he eat it?" He said: "No."
I said, "Then may he throw it away?" He said: "Then another expiation would be upon him."
He said: I said, "Then what should he do with it?" He said: "He should bury it."

key_terms.فَيَأْكُلُهُ: whether he may eat the slaughtered bird
key_terms.فَيَطْرَحُهُ: whether he may discard or throw it away
key_terms.فِدَاءٌ آخَرُ: an additional expiation incurred by improper disposal
key_terms.ٱلْحَرَمِ: the sacred sanctuary in which special protections apply
key_terms.ٱلْفِدَاءُ: the required expiation or compensatory penalty

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone kills a pigeon from the Haram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about slaughtering a pigeon from the Haram: expiation is required. The meat may neither be eaten nor discarded, and if it is thrown away, an additional expiation becomes due. The proper course is to bury it.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2356 - Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Khallad, from Abu Abdullah (as), regarding a man who slaughtered a pigeon from the pigeons of the Haram.
Imam (as) said: "He must offer an expiation (fidya)."
I asked: "Can he eat it?"
Imam (as) replied: "No."
I asked:"Can he throw it away?"
Imam (as) replied: "If he does, another expiation will be required."
I asked: "Then what should he do with it?"
Imam (as) said: "He should bury it."
